b'# tinydl

A simple command-line tool for downloading data from URLs.

## Usage

```
tinydl url [-o output] [-q]
```

## Options

- `url` (required): The URL to download data from.
- `-o, --output`: File to write the downloaded data to. Default is stdout.
- `-q, --quiet`: Suppress progress output.

## Examples

```
# Download to stdout
tinydl https://example.com/data.txt

# Download to a file
tinydl https://example.com/data.txt -o data.txt

# Quiet mode
tinydl https://example.com/data.txt -q
```
'
